brief.subject: Chapter 03 — 에이전트의 날갯짓
brief.goal: 4 s chapter bumper in the intro's chalk-on-blueprint style, played right before chapter 03

visualStyle.medium: Chalk-on-blueprint SVG line drawing: strokes draw themselves, static grain erodes every line
visualStyle.lighting: Deep navy board (canvas-deep) with cream chalk (paper) and a single amber accent (primary)
visualStyle.typography: Display serif (Playfair Display) for the chapter number, mono (JetBrains Mono) for the kicker, Pretendard 800 for the Korean chapter title
visualStyle.density: One chapter card, generous negative space
visualStyle.cameraFeeling: Slow push-in, then a zoom-through dive into the ring

beats.visual: Amber spark at the top of a chalk ring that draws itself with ruler ticks; the serif chapter number writes itself inside
beats.notes: Number lands on the impact at 0.94 s.

beats.visual: Kicker types in amber mono, an amber bar draws, the Korean title is handwritten with an amber dot; the chapter rail checks past chapters and sparks the current one
beats.notes: Hold from 2.4 s; nothing new appears after 2.6 s.

beats.visual: Board dives through the ring and fades to the clean canvas
beats.notes: Ends on the empty board so the next slide crossfades in cleanly.

audio.soundDesign: Spark chime, whoosh as the ring draws, key clicks for the kicker, impact when the number lands, bell for the dot and the rail spark, reverse whoosh on the exit
audio.music: Procedural Web Audio (code, no samples, no generative AI): 96 BPM pad + plucks on the intro progression, one chord per chapter (Bm, G, A, D). Rendered offline from a fixed seed, synced to the scene clock.
